actor_reflection.analysis: The strategy failed fundamentally because no tools were selected. For a text-based XAI question asking to identify least responsible features, tool selection is mandatory to process the input text and compute feature attributions. The empty tool list directly caused the downstream failure.
strategy_suggestions: Select at least one text processing or attribution tool to extract and evaluate input features.
Ensure the tool selection pipeline receives the original review text as context.
Use tools specifically designed for feature importance ranking in NLP models.
